headline: Colonials Rebound in Nevish Line as Callahan's Passage Erupts
war_summary: Since the noon dispatch, Colonial forces have clawed back ground along the Nevish Line, lifting their tally to two strongholds and paring Warden control to six amid unbroken combat at Princefal and Blackcoat Way. Fresh devastation has unseated Warden defenders in the Weathered Expanse, where another fortification crumbled into neutral no-man's-land, leaving three unoccupied ruins beside five Colonial and one lone Warden outpost following five rapid clashes. Simultaneously, Callahan’s Passage exploded into a furious bloodletting, logging more than twenty-two hundred combined casualties within two hours even as all ten bases remain in Warden hands. Across Kuura Strand, renewed contention over Faden Point loosened the front into four Colonial redoubts, one Warden hold, and one contested ruin. By contrast, the bitter fighting that previously seized Marban Hollow and the Linn of Mercy has cooled significantly, with frontline events subsiding into watchful standoff, while the prolonged attrition in Dead Lands slowed to a modest rumble.
